summary: Mission Produce filed an 8-K announcing antitrust clearance from Mexico's COFECE for its previously announced acquisition of Calavo Growers. The merger is expected to close on May 28, 2026. A joint proxy statement/prospectus was filed and mailed to stockholders. No price, premium, or advisors are stated in this 8-K. The filing updates on regulatory conditions; completion remains subject to other conditions. Watch for any last-minute regulatory or shareholder issues; the risk-arb spread may narrow as the close date approaches.
